controlledCold.conditions: Fresh Chromium context, cleared browser cache, synthetic 400 KiB/s up/down and 60 ms round-trip latency; not a physical phone/carrier.

rafPerformance.method: One context at a time, active visible normal new battle, at least 2 s warmup, three serial 5 s requestAnimationFrame samples. HUD screenshots before/after show the game remained visibly active. No private game state was read.

phone844x390.scope: Chromium viewport plus CDP touch emulation on the Windows host; not a physical phone. The CLI context lacked hasTouch, so the visible Start button used a normal click before sampling.

offline.download: The normal Download Offline flow reached ready before the reporting expression raised a harness-only ReferenceError after completion.
offline.reload: Browser explicitly offline; actual reload displayed 離線中，可玩單人戰役.
